summary: Reviewed V1.6 base, report-card and post-integration acceptance matrices: base 190 existing tests; proposed 19 base disciplines, 22 RC test scenarios, 16 post-integration P0 scenarios. Identified expanded optional QA program: model-based and property-based state machines, API/crash fault injection at all remote publication boundaries, adversarial capability and untrusted document tests, mutation tests, multi-hour soak and database recovery, synthetic 1-to-500 worker load, and real manual High worker behavioral measurements. Analysis only: no code or branch/topology changes.
